profile.summary: A private foundation based in San Francisco. It funds work in California public education, including educator preparation, school and system capacity, and advocacy and research. It also supports families with young children in San Francisco. It says it does not accept unsolicited proposals.

review.notes: silvergiving.org is a San Francisco grantmaking foundation (One Lombard St) focused on California P-12 education, matching the agenda's San Francisco location and a grant for a school; the summary's focus areas and the no-unsolicited-proposals statement are confirmed on the site (the latter on /grantees/becoming-a-grantee, not a cited page). Legal name, phone and address are confirmed on the contact page. Nonprofit/private status is not stated on either cited page, so orgType is unsupported; the summary's word 'private' is likewise unconfirmed but minor.
